en-US.lesson.lesson_cozy_words_1.title: Find the Soft Cushion
en-US.lesson.lesson_cozy_words_1.step_1.prompt: Can you tap the soft cushion?
en-US.lesson.lesson_cozy_words_1.step_1.celebr: You found the soft cushion with gentle hands!
en-US.lesson.lesson_cozy_words_1.step_2.prompt: Now let us tap the cozy blanket.
en-US.lesson.lesson_cozy_words_1.step_2.celebr: There is the cozy blanket, warm and ready!
en-US.lesson.lesson_cozy_words_1.closing_win: We explored our cozy words together and finished with a song!
en-US.lesson.lesson_cozy_pairs_2.title: Match Rest-Time Helpers
en-US.lesson.lesson_cozy_pairs_2.step_1.prompt: Let us find the folded towel for our tidy shelf.
en-US.lesson.lesson_cozy_pairs_2.step_1.celebr: The folded towel is ready on the shelf!
en-US.lesson.lesson_cozy_pairs_2.step_2.prompt: Let us tap the wooden block to put beside it.
en-US.lesson.lesson_cozy_pairs_2.closing_win: We grouped our helpers together as a team!
en-US.lesson.lesson_fallback_calm.title: Calm Picture Look
en-US.lesson.lesson_fallback_calm.step_1.promp: Tap the cozy shape when you are ready.
en-US.lesson.lesson_fallback_calm.step_1.celeb: Thank you for tapping along together!
en-US.lesson.lesson_fallback_calm.closing_win: What a calm moment we shared together!
en-US.scaffold.l0.prompt: Take a look at all the pictures and tap when ready.
en-US.scaffold.l1.prompt: Here are two calm choices—tap the one we noticed.
en-US.scaffold.l2.prompt: Watch the gentle glow, then tap the glowing picture.
en-US.scaffold.l3.prompt: Let us do it together—I will point, and you make the final tap.

en-US.mission.mission_cushion_nest.title: Cozy Cushion Nest Together
en-US.mission.mission_cushion_nest.parent_scri: Invite your child to walk with you and place one soft household item on the rug together.
en-US.mission.mission_cushion_nest.child_promp: Let us bring one soft item to our rug together.
en-US.mission.mission_cushion_nest.team_goal: Build a calm resting spot together as a family team.
en-US.mission.mission_cushion_nest.precheck: Please confirm the floor path is clear and an adult is present beside the child.
en-US.mission.mission_cushion_nest.return_ritu: Welcome back from your cozy nest—let us hum our closing notes together.
en-US.mission.mission_cushion_nest.safety_1: Walk slowly on flat ground and choose only large, soft household items.
en-US.routine.routine_evening_tidy.title: Evening Tidy Together
en-US.routine.routine_evening_tidy.parent_scri: Before bedtime stories, place one soft blanket or towel in its resting spot together.
en-US.routine.routine_evening_tidy.child_promp: Let us rest the blanket in its cozy spot together.
en-US.routine.routine_evening_tidy.team_goal: Settle our room together for a peaceful evening.
en-US.routine.routine_evening_tidy.return_ritu: Our room feels calm and settled—thank you for helping together.
en-US.routine.routine_evening_tidy.safety_1: Keep pathways clear and stay on the same floor level with an adult.
